title: run_verify
description: Run the checks of a change and write evidence. `quick` runs only the fast checks (`check --quick`); otherwise the full `verify`, which judges every typed acceptance line and writes evidence with a fingerprint.

change.description: A change ID, for example CHG-PORT-001.

agent.description: Who is acting, for example claude or cursor. The engine records it as ai:<agent> and never as a person. Default: mcp.
